homonyms.basis: The MMRS census row carries no disambiguation field (nor negative_tags or battery); no card is a homonym. 'Data Provenance Explorers' (MIT Media Lab's title, plural) names the same tool. 'DPI', the Initiative's own short form, is in the archive also #261's distinction preservation index (a metric of the specification, §6.4) and is not an alias. The general concept 'data provenance' (the tracking of the origins of data, F23; in computer science W3C PROV, named by #725) is a sense of the term, not of the entity.
distinct_entities: Open Model Evolution and the AI Observatory (the Initiative's other measurement systems)
papers-with-code (named in B6 as a crowdsourced aggregator the audit measured)
C2PA / Content Credentials and W3C PROV (the other provenance frameworks #725 sets beside it)

captures.description: THE DATA PROVENANCE EXPLORER, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'an interactive audit tool built by the Data Provenance Initiative to track, inspect, and filter large language model (LLM) training datasets'; a dataset explorer of 'nearly 4,000 text, speech, and video datasets' by creators, sources, geographies, modalities and derivation chains; licence and use filtering; web-data and consent explorers. Six cards: the Initiative's pages (four), MIT Media Lab, Cohere.
